_readme: Synthetic GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} responses, one per candidate in
trending.html. Fields are the subset the admission floors read, in the shape
Timestamps are absolute and the test pins fetch_sources.NOW to
2026-08-12T06:00:00Z, so every age below is exact and stays exact. A fixture
using relative dates would drift into a test that passes for a different
reason than it was written for.
Three keys are not repositories: _403, _404 and _raise name failures the
stub client performs instead of answering.
topics/machine-learning is here because it is shaped exactly like an
owner/repo pair and no regex can tell them apart. It is caught by the API
answering 404, which is the fail-closed rule doing the work a maintained
denylist of reserved GitHub paths would otherwise have to do badly.
